description: Public ChatGPT is conditionally permitted to support learning, subject to module-level directions and academic-integrity restrictions.
howToObtain: Use a public ChatGPT account only where the module tutor permits it; the policy gives no University account or access path.
costToUser: Not provided by the University; public plan costs vary.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: The University of Southampton's official policy says students are allowed to use GenAI tools like ChatGPT to support learning only where their module tutor permits it; use can be disallowed for particular learning outcomes or assessments and GenAI-created work must not be submitted as the student's own.

University of Southampton guidance says students are allowed to use GenAI tools like ChatGPT to develop learning and support studies, but should never submit work created or part-created by GenAI for assessments they claim as their own.
